create_LoFTREncoderLayer: create a LoFTREncoderLayer with d_model, nhead, and attention type for self or cross attention
build_LocalFeatureTransformer: build a LocalFeatureTransformer module from a config dict with d_model, nhead, layer_names, and attention settings
run_transformer_forward: run the LocalFeatureTransformer forward pass on two feature tensors with optional masks to produce transformed features
test_LoFTREncoderLayer_attention: test the LoFTREncoderLayer forward method with query, source tensors and optional masks for linear or full attention
review_LocalFeatureTransformer_layers: review the LocalFeatureTransformer layer iteration logic that alternates between self and cross attention layers
